Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the first place mentioned by name in the Book of Esther (New International Version). The first verse of the Book of Esther in the NIV reads: "In the days of Xerxes, the great king who ruled over 127 provinces from India to Ethiopia..." The first proper noun (place) mentioned is "India" (or "Ethiopia" depending on translation nuances, but "India" is the first geographical entity listed in the NIV text provided in standard bibles). The agent incorrectly assumed the first place was "Susa" (Shushan), which is the capital city mentioned later in the book (Chapter 1, Verse 2), but not the first place mentioned in the very first verse. This fundamental error in biblical text retrieval led the agent to search for the Prime Minister of Iran instead of India, resulting in the wrong answer (Amir-Abbas Hoveyda) rather than the correct answer (Morarji Desai, the Prime Minister of India in April 1977).
